criteria.description: Single token-resolution point: every runtime Vikunja consumer resolves the token via get_vikunja_token_path(); no runtime module hand-loads a felix-bot token path (SC-001).
criteria.evidence: WP01 added get_vikunja_token_path() (scripts/common/vikunja_config.py); client routes through it (WP01); 13 consumers routed (habits WP02, escalation+enrichment WP03, sync+credential-health WP04). SC-001 gate `git grep -nE 'secrets/vikunja-api([^-]|$)' -- scripts ':!**/__pycache__/**'` returns only the enumerated admin/one-shot + guard/refusal + docs allowlist; per-WP grep confirmed clean at each approve.
criteria.notes: Consumer inventory made exhaustive after the post-plan Codex review + git-grep sweep (escalation/enrichment were missed in the first pass).

criteria.description: Behavior-preserving centralization: each migrated consumer's Vikunja effects are unchanged (NFR-001).
criteria.evidence: Consumer suites green with zero regressions: habits 755 passed, escalation+enrichment 383 passed (baseline 383), sync+credential-health 258 passed. Token resolved at read-site (WP02/WP03) to preserve early-exit/validation ordering + dry-run; _read_token/PATCH/comment flows untouched.
criteria.notes: Sync NFR-001 failure-classification preserved by widening the preamble catch to (OSError, VikunjaConfigError); byte-identical parity test added (WP04).

criteria.description: The atomic flip: the single resolution point defaults to the kent token (vikunja-api-kent).
criteria.evidence: get_vikunja_token_path() default = /data/services/openclaw/secrets/vikunja-api-kent (WP01). SC-002 single-point-flip proof test green (tests/common/test_vikunja_token_seam.py): one lever (VIKUNJA_TOKEN_PATH) moves both the helper and a default VikunjaClient(); apply_reply stays kent-pinned (does not follow the override).
criteria.notes: Runtime felix-bot->kent transition is inert until the office2 pull (attended cutover, IC-07).

criteria.description: Retire felix-bot from the runtime path: remove the route_someday 403 fail-soft (#750); mark the vikunja-api credential dormant/non-runtime, kent sole runtime.
criteria.evidence: WP05: route_someday 403 fail-soft removed -> fail-loud RouteSomedayError (names the created task id); network-error-also-surfaces test added; unprovisioned-degrade preserved. WP06: credential-manifest vikunja-api status=retired, runtime=false, dormant (user/file retained, Inbox 14 preserved); vikunja-api-kent = sole runtime credential. Validators green.
criteria.notes: felix-bot Vikunja user left dormant (not deprovisioned) per C-002; GitHub kg-felix-bot unaffected per C-003.

criteria.description: Validator convergence: validate_refs exercises the same token view as the runtime (#748).
criteria.evidence: WP05: validate_refs.py default token now resolves via get_vikunja_token_path() (same single source as the runtime) — the independent DEFAULT_KENT_TOKEN_FILE literal removed; --token-file override preserved. Test proves the default equals the runtime resolution point (no independent literal); 30 passed.
criteria.notes: Closes the structural blindness that hid #860 (validator on kent, runtime on felix-bot).

criteria.description: Attended Tier-2 cutover + verification tooling. The mergeable deliverable is the deterministic verification tool; the live cutover (IC-07) + SC-004/SC-005 (live per-consumer verification, inverse probe, rebaseline) are the attended post-merge operator step by design.
criteria.evidence: WP08: scripts/vikunja/cutover_verify.py built + tested (18 passed) — read-only (grep-audited: no post/put/patch/delete), token via get_vikunja_token_path(); --inverse-probe (asserts projects 16-20 + Inbox 1 + Habits 13), --connectivity, --task-delta. The live attended Tier-2 cutover on office2 runs post-merge with a Restic snapshot <=24h and before/after connectivity (spec IC-07); NOT yet run at accept time (by design).
criteria.notes: PARTIAL-by-design: the code deliverable (verification tooling) is complete and is the mergeable artifact; SC-004/SC-005 live verification + rebaseline run at the attended cutover, gated on the operator (Kent), before feat->main deploys the flip.
